subject: Online cars in BO3
author: Xandu
body:
The cars you use online in Burnout 3 are the same as the ones you have unlocked in the offline game. If the host locks the cars to a specific series you will be given the minimum car in that series if you have no cars of that type unlocked.

-- The Creator --

subject: If you host they will come...
author: ZombieTron
body:
Wednesdays is the only day I am pretty much garunteed to be able to play due to not having any other commitments (except over the christmas holidays).

However, if you want to host a room on Fridays and advertise it here, I'm sure you will get people to join you.

After tomorrow's event, the next Wednesday will be Christmas Eve and the one after that is New Year's Eve so Xandu and I will not be able to host over the holidays as we will be spending the time with family and friends.

Weekly Wednesdays will start again in the new year. We hope you all have a merry christmas and a happy new year!

Hope to see you on Burnout 3 tomorrow! 🙂
